name: Yosemite
about: How much of what this tile shows is measured, ruled, guessed or blank, per layer (pipeline/scorecard.py; docs/tile-scorecards.md). Each layer states its definitions.

shares_meaning.measured: from data of this place at the layer's resolution
shares_meaning.ruled: a hand or named rule applied to a measured class, or a coarser measurement resampled
shares_meaning.guessed: stand-ins, back-fills, records x niche, generated traits, painted fills

definition.resolution: 1 m (the ground detail the client draws and the 1 m channels are routed on)
definition.measured: ground from a 1 m bare-earth lidar DEM product (terrain.dem_1m coverage.share_1m) or from a lidar point cloud's ground returns where no product exists (terrain/lidar_stats.json ground_from_points.share), less the road corridors re-graded by rule
definition.ruled: a coarser measurement of this place resampled to the drawn grid (3DEP seamless 5-10 m, Copernicus 30 m), plus the road corridors whose cut and fill were removed by rule (unroad corridor_share)
definition.guessed: none on any tile today (no ground is invented)

detail.elsewhere: LANDFIRE cover and height classes (30 m)

findings.text: 100% of the tile has no measured crowns (placed by rule from LANDFIRE cover and height classes (30 m))

definition.measured: covered by a lidar point cloud: crowns and heights found in the returns (manifest status.lidar_coverage.point_cloud)
definition.ruled: crowns placed by rule to match a canopy map: a satellite canopy-height model (Meta, ETH, 10 m) or LANDFIRE cover and height classes (30 m)
definition.not_scored: the understory under the canopy: only the top surface is kept on every tile (vegetation.canopy_height_10m band 3 is shrub cover where the top surface is 0.5-4 m)

detail.pre_settlement_note: cells whose community is a LANDFIRE Biophysical Settings (pre-settlement) class, drawn where today's land is developed, farmed or ruderal (communities[].source bps). fractions.from_bps_backfill is larger where the tile has permanent ice or rewilded reservoir beds: it counts every cell not from today's map

findings.text: 1% of cells are a back-filled class (pre-settlement under developed or farmed land, by the baseline rule), not today's vegetation

definition.unit: share of the tile's 30 m cells (species_mix.json communities[].cells)
definition.measured: a cell whose species composition is mapped (plot-based maps such as TreeMap): no tile uses one today
definition.ruled: a hand rule (pipeline/species_mix.py RULES) or a named_from_* rule (the species the community's name names) applied to a measured existing-vegetation class (source evt); open water and permanent ice (rules that draw no plants); a tile_pool_* community with no woody donor that draws only the grasses and forbs of its own description or the region's ground table (ground_only)
definition.guessed: the tile pool (tile_pool_*: another community's species of the same habitat class), research_* (the tile's recorded species weighted by records x niche), recorded_* (a community whose name names nothing: the shrubs recorded on its own cells, pipeline/associates.py), habitat_default_* (California's foothill default), and every cell whose class is a back-fill rather than today's vegetation (source bps: pre-settlement LANDFIRE BpS under human land; rewild: former reservoir beds; habitat: no class)
definition.blank: a tile_pool_* community with no donor and no ground plants: drawn bare, nothing known

status.note: no status field in this build

detail.no_local_record_note: share of the drawn woody weight whose drawn species is not among the tile's most-recorded GBIF plants (species/plant_needs.json, research.PLANT_LIMIT): common trees can miss that list, so this is a lead, not a finding

definition.unit: share of the tile's drawn woody plant weight (trees and shrubs): each community's cells x its tree or shrub density x a species' share of the weights its rule wrote (species_mix.json communities[])
definition.resolution: the species drawn in each 30 m cell
definition.measured: a species share taken from a per-cell composition measurement: none on any tile today
definition.ruled: drawn as the species the community's rule asked for (it has a library record of its own)
definition.guessed: drawn as a stand-in for the species the rule asked for: the mix's `stand_ins` key when the build records it, else `substitutions` (named species -> record drawn); research_* rows whose note names functional stand-ins of the climate group; and a community layer whose every species is missing, drawn from the tile's other communities of its habitat class (communities[].generic, generic_drawn)
definition.blank: asked for but drawn as nothing: the mix's `missing` key when recorded, else a substitution to null (unless the community's layer is drawn generic: then guessed)
definition.status: detail.status: introduced, restored and status_unknown counts over the drawn species (trees, shrubs, ground), from a per-species `status` on species/plant_needs.json needs[] or a species_status map in the mix; 'no status field in this build' until one exists

definition.measured: the air photo kept where its native resolution is 2.5 m or finer (NAIP 0.6 m)
definition.ruled: the photo kept where it is coarser than the texture (Sentinel-2 10 m, resampled)
definition.guessed: ground painted in where the photo was replaced: under the 3D crowns, erased roads and buildings (client.texture_ground filled_fraction; on a tile without it, client.texture_imagery mask_fraction)

findings.text: 41% of stream length is placed by the DEM alone, no mapped stream confirms it

definition.unit: share of stream length (km): the drawn channels plus the mapped flowlines left undrawn
definition.measured: a drawn channel a mapped flowline confirms (NHDPlus HR in the US, OSM abroad): nhd_matched, or a mapped reach kept where the DEM found none (source nhd)
definition.ruled: a channel placed by the flow-accumulation threshold on the DEM with no mapped line to confirm it
definition.blank: mapped flowline length no drawn channel covers (hydro.channels stats nhd_length_km - nhd_covered_length_km - nhd_kept_length_km; includes the tips dropped by rule)
definition.not_scored: stream width, depth and discharge: width is the drainage-area rule (params.width) on every reach of every tile, so it is reported, not scored; lakes and ponds are not scored

status.note: no status field in this build

findings.text: no fish species listed (none in the tile's GBIF records)
no invertebrate species listed (6 in the records, none listed)

definition.unit: share of the listed species (species/animals.json animals[])
definition.resolution: the tile (10 km): is the species here
definition.measured: listed with GBIF records on the tile and traits from a published table or a curated card
definition.ruled: listed by a range or life-zone rule without records on the tile
definition.blank: none by species; kinds with no species at all (fish, ...) are findings instead
definition.status: detail.status: introduced, restored and status_unknown counts from a per-species `status` field (native | introduced | restored) on animals[]; 'no status field in this build' until one exists

findings.text: 46 of 95 listed animals wear a kin's body
3 of 95 listed animals are not drawn

definition.measured: drawn with a body of its own: a curated client species (fauna.json allow) or a slot with its own model file
definition.ruled: none (no rule makes a body from a measurement)
definition.guessed: drawn with a kin's body, scaled and tinted (fauna.json slots[].kin, no model of its own)
definition.blank: listed but not drawn (fauna.json skipped[], or absent from allow and slots)

findings.text: 100% of the tile has no measured crowns (placed by rule from LANDFIRE cover and height classes (30 m))
no fish species listed (none in the tile's GBIF records)
no invertebrate species listed (6 in the records, none listed)
46 of 95 listed animals wear a kin's body
41% of stream length is placed by the DEM alone, no mapped stream confirms it
3 of 95 listed animals are not drawn

not_scored.sea: no layer: the coast has no sea floor, tides or surf on any tile
not_scored.weather_and_seasons: one ERA5 series per tile (client/weather.json); no per-cell share to score
not_scored.sound: synthesised in the client; the build writes no sound document

species_lists.source: NPSpecies, the National Park Service's species list for Yosemite National Park (YOSE), IRMA
species_lists.licence: public domain (a work of the US National Park Service)
species_lists.attribution: National Park Service, NPSpecies - The National Park Service biodiversity database (IRMA)
species_lists.baseline: the rewilding baseline (docs/brief.md, 2026-11-10): introduced species are errors; natives the list has as gone from the park are to be restored (drawn: a hit; lacking: a gap)
species_lists.measure: precision = drawn species the list has as present and native, or as a native gone from the park (restored) / drawn species the list decides on; recall = the list's present, native, Abundant or Common species that the tile lists / all of them
species_lists.limits: A park is larger than a 10 km tile: precision is sound for a tile inside the park; recall is an upper bound on what is missing (a species common in the park may live outside the tile's habitats), so expected_absent names candidates and only a whole missing group is certain. Invertebrates are not judged (the lists are incomplete).

composition.source: Inventory and Monitoring Division. 2022. Field data for the Vegetation Mapping Inventory Project of Yosemite National Park, Devils Postpile National Monument - Open Format Data Package. National Park Service. https://doi.org/10.57830/2312926
composition.drawn_from: client/species_mix.json: plants drawn per species (cells x density x weight), by layer
composition.measure: per layer, on genus shares: Bray-Curtis dissimilarity (0 same, 1 nothing in common); foreign share = drawn share in genera the reference does not record on this ground; missed share = reference share in genera not drawn in that layer
composition.limits: Classification plots were placed in stands chosen as typical of a vegetation type, not at random, and a 10 km tile holds few of them (rare types such as river banks are over-counted). The reference is percent cover; the drawn shares are counts of plants. The pipeline moves dwarf shrubs to its ground layer; the plots record them as short shrubs. Read the scores as a ranking of what is most wrong.

structure.why: GEDI needs a NASA Earthdata login, which only the owner can create
needs: a free Earthdata account (urs.earthdata.nasa.gov) made by Aaron, and its token in the git-ignored .env as EARTHDATA_TOKEN (never printed or logged)

GEDI L2A (footprint canopy height, rh98) and L2B (canopy cover, plant area index, vertical profile) version 2 granules over the tile, found through NASA's CMR search by bounding box and subset to the tile through Harmony or read from the cloud-optimised HDF5 with h5py (h5py is not in the venv yet); NASA data are open (no licence restriction), attribution to the GEDI mission (Dubayah et al.)

per 25 m footprint with quality_flag 1 and sensitivity >= 0.95, leaf-on shots only: the tile's own canopy height (the height the client draws: client/canopy.png and the canopy_top step) sampled at the footprint, then bias, RMSE and rank correlation of height, and the same for cover

held out only where the tile's canopy does not come from GEDI: the ETH and Meta canopy-height maps used on the six tiles without lidar were trained on GEDI, so on those tiles GEDI is not independent; on the eight lidar tiles it is. GEDI covers 51.6 N to 51.6 S: not Lofoten
the alternative with no account: hold out part of the 3DEP lidar point cloud on US tiles (build from the DEM-only path, judge against the point cloud's canopy height model)

colour_from_above.what: colour from straight above (the d_topdown probe pose) against the Sentinel-2 composite of the capture's month, through the viewer's light (tools/probes/run.sh, sheet.py overlap_fair)
colour_from_above.why_not_held_out: the ground texture is made from the same family of imagery, so this score is satisfied by construction where the ground shows; it cannot see a wrong species, a missing understory or an empty river
colour_from_above.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (the seasons step's monthly composite)
colour_from_above.why: the tile has no probe in tools/probes/probes.json

eye_level.source: geotagged ground photos from Wikimedia Commons and iNaturalist (tools/probes/eye_photos.py)
eye_level.licence: per photo, one of CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA; author, licence and page of each in tiles/utm11n_270_4180/judge/eye_photos.json
eye_level.measure: per pair, on three bands of each image: the difference of sky shares, of the green share of the land, and CIE76 delta E of the land's mean colour; distance = mean(sky_diff, green_diff, min(delta_e / 50, 1)), 0 = the same by these statistics
eye_level.limits: Colour and cover statistics by image band only: no species, shape or texture. Season, weather, hour, exposure, the photo's unknown lens and tilt, and GPS error all move the number. The sheets are for a person to judge; the number ranks gross mismatches.
